title: Use string resources in ManageProfilesScreen composable
name: ManageProfilesScreen
description: Replace hardcoded literals, including the templated 'Edit $name' content description, with stringResource() calls. Navigation/state/callback logic unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Info/settings icon contentDescriptions use the shared about/settings_label resources
'Edit ${profile.name}' uses stringResource(R.string.edit_item_content_desc, profile.name) -- the same shared resource used for the medication edit action
